text.content:
The factory belt: plants, docks, depots and the rail terminal.

Region: Santo Domingo (district M). Was: the Heywood Industrial Zone, Heywood Docks, North Heywood
Controlled by: Corporate security inside the fences; the NCPD by day, 6th Street by night, and the Valentinos wherever 6th Street isn't looking
The feel of it: Factories that retool whenever a division rebrands, each guarding its secrets with its own army
Notable locations: Arasaka Industrial Park (#41), Night City Prison (#42), Red Dirt (#43), Dewdrop Inn (#44), the Forlorn Hope (#79), the Armory (#80), Zhirafa Office Park (#81), MetalStorm (#82), East Bay Terminal
Danger: Moderate / Corporate: Corporate inside the fences, Moderate in the streets. SC 7 (corporate site security and NCPD, Hardened Medium). UC 3

Shift workers live in company dorms and old North Heywood row houses, with truckers, rail workers and nomads at the East Bay Terminal; H6 is a worker megabuilding with a factory clinic on every floor. The Aldecaldos are welcome at the terminal and in Red Dirt, and nobody argues with them.

Recent History

  • 2050s: North Heywood's factories expand and merge into Arroyo.
  • 2069–2070: The Unification War makes Arroyo the city's arsenal, every plant on triple shifts. Since the Accord, half are idle.
  • 2070: Arasaka buys the idle plants around its Industrial Park. 6th Street loses the protection money and starts a war with the Valentinos.

Places

  • Arasaka Industrial Park (#41). SC 10. Warehouses, a rail spur and a container yard. Not extraterritorial, but it acts like it.
  • Night City Prison (#42). SC 10. Over capacity since the Purge; half the inmates are association cases.
  • Dewdrop Inn (#44). SC 5. Cheap motel, cheap bar, cheap fights.
  • Zhirafa Office Park (#81). SC 8. A heavy vehicle maker, hiring drivers and test pilots.
  • MetalStorm (#82). SC 5. A metal club and fight bar. Maelstrom shows up when it's bored.
  • East Bay Terminal. SC 7. Regional rail and customs; the customs officers are for sale by the hour.

Getting There

NCART: Heywood Docks, East Bay Terminal, Santo Cruz, Arroyo Industrial (Crosstown, Southern Line).

Turf

6th Street, with the Valentinos pushing in from the west.

People

  • "General" Rick Morton (Ganger 8). Leader of 6th Street.
  • Doc Mags (Medtech 8). Runs a clinic above a Santo Cruz pharmacy.
  • Mitch "Dakota" Calloway (Nomad 6, Aldecaldos). The family's man at the terminal.
  • Warden Lisa Krull (Solo 5). Runs Night City Prison, and quietly releases association cases early.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.11
